scenario: [LCON.2.4.1] where a negation is decided by facts the same pump derives. A ids 1, 2, 3, 5 in three insertion orders. `derive` emits B(a.id) for every A; `orphan` fires for an A whose predecessor id has no B. While the asserts are queued every `orphan` activation is live (no B exists yet); `derive` is declared first, so all four of its activations fire before any `orphan` ([LDET.5.4]), and each B withdraws the `orphan` activation it negates. Only A(5) has no B(4): four `derive`, one `orphan`, and 4 A + 4 B + 1 C = 9 facts, in every order. A runtime that let insertion order decide when a negated activation is withdrawn fires `orphan` for 2 or 3 in some order and not others.
rules_ds:
schema A scope logical:
    id: Int key

schema B scope logical:
    id: Int key

schema C scope logical:
    id: Int key

rule derive:
    A a
->
    emit B logical id: a.id

rule orphan:
    A a where a.id > 1
    no B b where b.id == a.id - 1
->
    emit C logical id: a.id
